data_contract.entry_evaluation: all features use candles whose values were fully known before the candidate entry timestamp
data_contract.higher_timeframes: 1h and 4h rebuilt only from complete 15m buckets

feature_definitions.h4_structure_bias: compare the most recent six completed 4h candles with the preceding six; bullish requires both a higher range high and higher range low, bearish requires both lower
feature_definitions.premium_discount: position of the last closed 15m price inside the prior 20 completed 4h dealing range; long matches discount <= 0.50, short matches premium >= 0.50
feature_definitions.h4_poi: touch of a recent completed 4h three-candle imbalance/FVG or the origin candle immediately preceding a directional 4h displacement bar
feature_definitions.h1_liquidity_raid: within the most recent four completed 1h candles, a sweep beyond the preceding 12-candle extreme followed by a close back inside
feature_definitions.m15_bos: last closed 15m candle closes beyond the prior eight-candle high for long or low for short
feature_definitions.m15_displacement: directional body >= 0.60 ATR14, volume >= 1.20 SMA20, and close in the directional outer quartile of the candle
feature_definitions.m15_imbalance: three-candle 15m FVG on the last closed candle
feature_definitions.m15_idm: within the most recent four 15m candles, a sweep of a preceding five-candle internal extreme followed by a close back inside
feature_definitions.volume_confirmation: m15_bos and either m15_displacement or m15_imbalance

candidates.name: SMC_RAID_BOS_CHAIN
candidates.rule: bias + premium/discount + h1 raid + m15 BOS

candidates.name: SMC_POI_VC_CHAIN
candidates.rule: bias + premium/discount + h4 POI + volume confirmation

candidates.name: SMC_IDM_BOS_CHAIN
candidates.rule: bias + premium/discount + m15 IDM + BOS + displacement

candidates.name: SMC_HYBRID_SCORE_7
candidates.rule: bias + score >= 7 + at least one of POI/raid + volume confirmation

candidates.name: SMC_SOFT_SCORE
candidates.rule: bias required; risk multiplier 1.00 for score >=8, 0.80 for 6-7, 0.50 for 4-5, 0.25 below 4

development_gate.selection_rule: freeze at most one passing candidate by highest pooled PF, then lowest DD, then positive-fold percentage, then trade count

anti_overfit_rules: No candidate, threshold or coefficient changes after viewing results.
No symbol exclusions after viewing results.
No external holdout access unless exactly one candidate passes development.
This package is a deterministic research formalization, not a claim of exact equivalence to the user's discretionary manual method.
